name: Rhythm Land
author: martendo (programming, music), Adrian-kwok (art, design); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: Rhythm Land by martendo and Adrian-kwok (Sinusoid Studios), a rhythm game for the Game Boy made for the Game Boy Competition 2021: a collection of short music games, like the skateboarding one, where you press the button on the beat. MIT license (github.com/sinusoid-studios/rhythm-land).

descriptions.it: Rhythm Land di martendo e Adrian-kwok (Sinusoid Studios), un gioco ritmico per Game Boy realizzato per la Game Boy Competition 2021: una raccolta di brevi giochi musicali, come quello dello skateboard, in cui bisogna premere il tasto a tempo di musica. Licenza MIT (github.com/sinusoid-studios/rhythm-land).
